name: choir
generatedComment: GENERATED by lua tools/bank/bank_build.lua --recipe art/music/bank/choir-real-recipe.json from the sources of art/music/bank/choir-real.manifest.tsv (lua tools/brood_choir/pins.lua fetch; lua tools/brood_choir/brood.lua cut --recipe art/music/choir/real.json); do not edit.
comment: The brood choir from real samples (openspec/changes/demon-choir design §11), a candidate beside art/music/bank/choir-recipe.json (the approved formant + ACE-Step choir): same name, roles, levels and budgets, so building it replaces web/audio/bank/choir.json and its sprites behind the same bank switch. brood: epic-choir's B part (VocalSet's ten male singers, CC BY 4.0), oh/ah at the f dynamic, five roots a major third apart, vowel by velocity as before; the A#2 zones stretch 6 semitones down to the score's E2 drones (measured against two kept formant zones, design §11.3). grunt: 272 Merry Orks (CC0) misc shouts, a female voice cut and pitched -7 semitones by brood.lua so their brightness matches the ACE-Step grunts' at the same runtime shift (one nominal root, C3). warcry: the approved ACE-Step cuts, unchanged. Bank fidelity (adaptive-soundtrack design §12.11): brood declipped (the f takes reach full scale), the hall's stereo summed to mono (L/R correlation 0.2-0.4: the fold loses level to decorrelation, not to comb notches; the sum's loop seams and codec SNR measure cleaner than one channel), DC removed; rates by the 35 dB rule: brood 160 (36.4 dB; 128 gives 33.8), grunt and warcry 160 (the cap). Run ledger: plan/render-runs/demon-choir.md §10.

thepok/epic-choir.credit: Choir samples derived from VocalSet (Wilkins, Seetharaman, Wahl, Pardo 2018), CC BY 4.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1442513 — epic-choir by thepok. Changed for this game: cut, pitched, downmixed to mono and encoded to Opus. Licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

local/orks-picks.credit: 272 Merry Orks by Karoryfer Lecolds (CC0 1.0); cut and pitched by the Demon Attack project (tools/brood_choir)

local/acestep-picks.credit: Grunts and war cries rendered with ACE-Step 1.5 (MIT) in the project's studio

instruments.why: real singers (epic-choir B: 3-10 of VocalSet's male singers summed per note in a simulated hall), roots from B_oh.sfz/B_ah.sfz pitch_keycenter (the strict check: all within 0.46 semitone); the lowest zone reaches E2 by a 6-semitone shift, whose timbre changes 2-5 dB per semitone against a 22-23 dB step at a synth/real seam

272 Merry Orks shouts, softest to fiercest: a ugh, b oh, c hey, d argh, two round robins each, pitched -7 semitones (art/music/choir/real.json), then played from the nominal root C3 like the ACE-Step grunts; trim 0.7 s with a 0.3 s fade ends them 26-70 dB down (the ACE-Step cuts: 25-36)
the approved ACE-Step war cries, unchanged (art/music/bank/choir-recipe.json): Merry Orks' growled vowels were measured as the alternative and kept out (design §11.4)
